too_slow: The other machine is answering too slowly: request dropped.
reply_too_big_action_size: Reply to “{action}” too large ({size}, at most {limit}): refused.
reply_too_big_action: Reply to “{action}” too large (at most {limit}): refused.
reply_too_big_size: Reply too large ({size}, at most {limit}): refused.
compressed: Unexpected compressed reply ({encoding}) from another machine: refused.
unreadable_reply: Unreadable reply from the other machine.
frame_too_big: Reply chunk too large (at most {limit}): reply interrupted.
still_busy: The other machine still hasn't finished answering an earlier request that was dropped: nothing more is asked of it for now.
no_path: No path to this machine (neither the local network nor the Internet).
unreachable_lan: Machine unreachable over the local network ({error}).
incompatible: Incompatible AIODOS version on this machine.
key_unreadable: The key for “{name}” is unreadable on this machine: pair it again.
streams_busy: Already {count} conversations in progress with this machine for {minutes} min: try again later.
clock_skew: The clocks of the two machines are too far apart.
busy_receiving: Machine busy receiving other large messages: try again in a moment.
unpaired_too_big: Machine not paired: request too large (at most {limit}).
unknown_address_too_big: Request too large (at most {limit}): this machine is not yet recognized at this address. Try again in a few seconds.
envelope_expected: Unreadable request: a JSON envelope is expected.
wrong_net_key: Unexpected Internet key from the caller for this machine.
wrong_net_key_pairing: Unexpected Internet key from the caller for this pairing.
